question: What particle size and release mechanism does Table 2 give for the SPIONs carrier?
expect: ~60 nm; Intracellular/Lysosomal Escape (siSnail2, PEN shell) (p6.T2 r17)
rendered: Table 2 does not give specific information about the SPIONs carrier. However, according to the text, Hu et al. developed PEN-coated SPIONs (CNP@siSnail2) targeting Snail2. The text states that "CNP@siSnail2 passively extravasates and accumulates within tumor tissues through the EPR effect, facilitating efficient delivery of siSnail2 to tumor cells."
